finalText:
**A small Node HTTP service, five files, no package.json and no tests.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  A[server.js] -->|checks token| B[auth.js]
  A --> C[routes.js]
  C --> D[cache.js]
  C --> E[store.js]
  D --> E
```

`server.js` opens the port and rejects anyone without a good token. `auth.js` checks bearer tokens signed with a shared secret. `routes.js` holds three routes and turns the result into JSON. Reads go through `cache.js`, a 256-entry cache. `store.js` is a fake database in memory, records expire after 15 minutes.

One thing to know: the comment says writes clear the cache, but `putOrder` never does. So `GET /orders` keeps serving the old list after a `POST`.
